author: Seung Wook
problem: The vertices of a regular pentagon are A, B, C, D and E. Given two segments as two-letter strings S and T (each naming two different vertices), print Yes if the two segments have the same length, otherwise No.
bug_description: The lookup string ABCDEABCDE only holds adjacent pairs in one direction, so a side written backwards (like BA or ED) is treated as a diagonal.

comments.accurate: Checks whether each segment is a side or a diagonal of the pentagon and prints Yes if both are the same kind
comments.wrong_behavior: A segment is a side when its letters appear next to each other in ABCDEABCDE, otherwise a diagonal
comments.wrong_location: Side lookup verified; check that the two input lines are read without trailing whitespace
